description: Free and Open source Web Builder Framework. Next generation tool for building templates without coding

latest_release.name: v0.23.9
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Improve CSSRule performance by @artf in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6844
* fix: move initial inline style to the default rule regardless of device and state by @RaphaelFakhri in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6843
* Add page frame events by @artf in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6845
* Fix resize issues in absolute mode by @artf in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6856
* fix: keep semicolons inside url() and quotes when parsing inline styles by @RaphaelFakhri in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6849
* Move backbone undo by @artf in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6857
* Improve docs by @artf in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6858

## New Contributors
* @RaphaelFakhri made their first contribution in https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/pull/6843

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GrapesJS/grapesjs/compare/v0.23.8...v0.23.9
